army_rules.name: Harbingers of Dread
army_rules.rules_text: If your Army Faction is CHAOS KNIGHTS, each unit from your army with this ability gains Dread abilities, depending which are active for your army. The Deathly Terror ability is active for your army from the start of the battle. In addition, at the start of the first, third and fifth battle rounds, you can either select one of the other Dread abilities or randomly select two Dread abilities to apply by rolling two D6 and applying the results rolled. You cannot select the same Dread ability more than once, and any duplicated Dread abilities are reselected. Any selected Dread abilities are active until the end of the battle.

options.name: Deathly Terror (Aura)
options.rules_text: While an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1.

options.name: Despair (Aura)
options.rules_text: While an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1. This is cumulative with the Deathly Terror ability.

options.name: Doom
options.rules_text: Each time this model makes an attack, if the target of that attack is Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Wound roll.

options.name: Dismay (Aura)
options.rules_text: In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, for each enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength and within 9" of this model, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

options.name: Delirium (Aura)
options.rules_text: While an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength is within 9" of this model, each time that unit fails a Battle-shock test, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

options.name: Dominion
options.rules_text: Add 3" to the range of this model's Aura abilities.

army_rules.name: Dreadblades
army_rules.rules_text: If every model from your army has the CHAOS keyword, you can include either 1 TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS model or up to 3 WAR DOG models in your army, even if they do not have the Faction keyword you selected in the Select Army Faction step. None of these models can be your WARLORD, and they cannot be given Enhancements.

army_rules.name: Super-heavy Walker
army_rules.rules_text: Each time a model with this ability makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them. It can also move through sections of terrain features that are more than 4" in height, but if it does, after it has moved, roll one D6: on a 1, that model is Battle-shocked.

rule.name: Paragons of Terror
rule.rules_text: At the start of the first battle round, after selecting one or more Dread abilities to be active for your army, you can select one additional Dread ability to be active for your army (this additional Dread ability cannot be randomly selected).

enhancements.name: Nightmare's Master
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Tyrant's Shadow
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. At the end of your Command phase, select one objective marker the bearer is within range of and that you control. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase. In addition, until you lose control of that objective marker, it has the Deathly Terror ability as if it were a CHAOS KNIGHTS model from your army.

enhancements.name: Malevolent Heraldry
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Each time you roll dice to randomly select which Dread abilities are active for your army (if the bearer is on the battlefield), you can re-roll one or both results rolled.

enhancements.name: Veil of Medrengard
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks, and a 5+ invulnerable save against melee attacks.

stratagems.name: Pterrorshades
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound and one model in your unit regains up to 1 lost wound.
restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Conquerors Without Mercy
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS model from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by your model by 1. After your model has finished making its attacks this phase, if it destroyed one or more enemy units this phase, each enemy unit within 6" of your model must take a Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: Disdain for the Weak
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks made by Battle-shocked models.

stratagems.name: A Long Leash
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ABHORRENT unit from your army and up to two friendly WAR DOG units.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, those WAR DOG units are treated as being within range of any Aura abilities your ABHORRENT unit has.

stratagems.name: Imperious Advance
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two WAR DOG units from your army or one TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but, unless it made a Charge move, cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape tests it automatically passed (the Super-heavy Walker ability does not apply while using this Stratagem).

stratagems.name: Storm of Darkness
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Stealth. Melee attacks that target your unit have -1 to Hit rolls.

rule.name: Malefic Surge
rule.rules_text: In your Command phase, one or more CHAOS KNIGHTS units from your army can make a Malefic Surge. Each one that does must then take a Leadership test; if that test is failed, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then, until the start of your next Command phase, that unit is Empowered. While a unit is Empowered it can use one of the Malefic Surge abilities below. Once that unit has used a Malefic Surge ability, it is no longer Empowered. Unholy Hunger: When a model in this unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, add 3" to its Move characteristic. Diabolic Power: When this unit is selected to shoot or fight, select either the LETHAL HITS or SUSTAINED HITS 1 ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in this unit have the selected ability. Unnatural Fortitude: When this unit is selected as the target of an attack, select one of the following to apply until the end of the phase: Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save; Models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

options.name: Diabolic Power - Lethal Hits
options.rules_text: This Empowered CHAOS KNIGHTS unit selected Diabolic Power. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in this unit have Lethal Hits.

options.name: Diabolic Power - Sustained Hits
options.rules_text: This Empowered CHAOS KNIGHTS unit selected Diabolic Power. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in this unit have Sustained Hits 1.

options.name: Unnatural Fortitude - Invulnerable Save
options.rules_text: This Empowered CHAOS KNIGHTS unit selected Unnatural Fortitude. Until the end of the phase, models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

options.name: Unnatural Fortitude - Feel No Pain
options.rules_text: This Empowered CHAOS KNIGHTS unit selected Unnatural Fortitude. Until the end of the phase, models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

enhancements.name: Knight Diabolus
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons by 1. While the bearer is using the Diabolic Power ability, its melee weapons have the Lance ability.

enhancements.name: Blasphemous Engine
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Add 2 to the bearer's Wounds characteristic. Each time the bearer's unit makes a Malefic Surge, you can re-roll the Leadership test taken to see if it suffers any mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Fleshmetal Fusion
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Add 1 to the bearer's Toughness characteristic. While the bearer is using the Unnatural Fortitude ability, each time an attack with a Damage characteristic of 1 is allocated to the bearer, add 1 to any armour saving throw made against that attack.

enhancements.name: Bestial Aspect
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer's ranged weapons have the Assault ability. While the bearer is using the Unholy Hunger ability, it can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and/or to Advance rolls made for its unit.

stratagems.name: Profane Symbiosis
stratagems.timing: End of any phase.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that is not Empowered.
stratagems.effect: Your unit makes a Malefic Surge.
restrictions: You cannot select the same unit as the target of this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Hellforged Construction
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Corrupting Taint
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army makes a Malefic Surge.
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker your unit is within range of that you control. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Unleash Balefire
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: After your unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test; if the test is failed, until the end of your opponent's next turn, it is aflame. While a unit is aflame, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it.

stratagems.name: Warp Vision
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the Ignores Cover ability.

stratagems.name: Diabolic Bulwark
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

rule.name: Tyrannical Court
rule.rules_text: Improve the Objective Control characteristic of CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER models from your army by 2. In addition, once per battle round, if your WARLORD is on the battlefield, you can use the Claimed for the Dark Gods Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: Throne Mechanicum of Skulls
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit. In addition, once per battle, in your Charge phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer's unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

enhancements.name: Blade of Celerity
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer's ranged weapons have the Assault ability. In addition, once per battle, in the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Warp-borne Stalker
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has the Deep Strike ability. In addition, once per battle, at the end of your opponent's turn, if the bearer is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Putrid Carapace
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+. In addition, once per battle, at the start of either player's Command phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer regains up to D6 lost wounds.

enhancements.name: Mirror of Fates
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12" of this model with a Stratagem, you can use this ability. If you do, increase the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

enhancements.name: Blessing of the Dark Master
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has the Stealth ability. In addition, once per battle, after your unit suffers one or more mortal wounds, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

stratagems.name: Claimed for the Dark Gods
stratagems.timing: Start of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.
stratagems.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control, with a Level of Control of 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Spiteful Demise
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: When rolling to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your unit's Deadly Demise ability, that model's Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of a 4+ instead of on a 6.

stratagems.name: Runes of Disdain
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Titanic Duel
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1. Each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if that enemy unit is TITANIC, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

stratagems.name: Trophy Hunter
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just before a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army consolidates.
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" as long as your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: Crushed Like Vermin
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army ends a Normal move.
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) that your unit moved over during that move and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If one or more models are destroyed as a result of this Stratagem, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

detachments.name: Houndpack Lance

rule.name: Marked Prey
rule.rules_text: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent's army. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a WAR DOG model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if that unit is visible to the attacking model, that attack has the Sustained Hits 1 ability.

additional_rules.name: Keywords
additional_rules.rules_text: While using the Houndpack Lance Detachment, the following rules apply: Your army must include three or more WAR DOG units. WAR DOG units from your army have the BATTLELINE keyword. When mustering your army, select three WAR DOG units from your army. Until the end of the battle, those units have the CHARACTER keyword.

restrictions: Your army must include three or more WAR DOG units.

enhancements.name: Preyslayer's Mantle
enhancements.rules_text: WAR DOG model only. The bearer has the Super-heavy Walker ability.

enhancements.name: Final Howl (Aura)
enhancements.rules_text: WAR DOG model only. While a friendly War Dog model is within 6" of the bearer, each time that model makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Loping Predator
enhancements.rules_text: WAR DOG model only. The bearer's ranged weapons have the Assault ability.

enhancements.name: Panoply of the Cursed Knight
enhancements.rules_text: WAR DOG model only. Each time an attack targets the bearer, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Vox-howl
stratagems.timing: Start of the Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One WAR DOG CHARACTER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. Each friendly WAR DOG unit that is within 6" of your unit and is Battle-shocked must take a Leadership test; if that test is passed, that unit is no longer Battle-shocked.
restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

stratagems.name: Hungry for Combat
stratagems.timing: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Two or more WAR DOG units from your army within Engagement Range of the same enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of those WAR DOG units. Until the end of the phase, models in those WAR DOG units can only target that enemy unit, but each time a model in one of those WAR DOG units makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Cunning Hunter
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after a WAR DOG unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That WAR DOG unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Animalistic Rage
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a WAR DOG unit from your army that has not been selected to attack this phase is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That WAR DOG unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Before resolving your unit's Deadly Demise ability, it can either shoot or fight. When doing so, it must target only the enemy unit that just destroyed it, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target. After it has done so and after any Consolidation moves have been made, resolve your unit's Deadly Demise ability as normal.

stratagems.name: Harrying Hounds
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One WAR DOG unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Encircling Pack
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One WAR DOG unit from your army that is wholly within 12" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

rule.name: Masters of the Pack
rule.rules_text: If a TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army has an Aura ability that affects friendly WAR DOG units, while two or more friendly WAR DOG models are within range of that TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit's Aura ability, that TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit is affected by that Aura ability as well.

enhancements.name: Aspect of the Beast
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. At the start of your Command phase, select one Dread ability to be active for the bearer until the start of your next Command phase, in addition to the Dread abilities active for your army.

enhancements.name: Hunter's Helm
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Octagram of Conjuration
enhancements.rules_text: KNIGHT ABOMINANT model only. The bearer has the following ability: Octagram of Conjuration (Aura): While a friendly WAR DOG model is within 9" of this model, after that WAR DOG model has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Throne Tyrannicus
enhancements.rules_text: TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. In your Command phase, select one other CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER model within 9" of the bearer. If the bearer has one or more Aura abilities that affect friendly WAR DOG units, until the start of your next Command phase, the selected CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER model is affected by those Aura abilities as well.

stratagems.name: Feral Arrogance
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army.
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Merciless Fusillade
stratagems.timing: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army, and up to two friendly WAR DOG units, that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit that is an eligible target for each of those CHAOS KNIGHTS units. Until the end of the phase, each time one of those Chaos Knights units is selected to shoot or fight, if that enemy unit is an eligible target, you can only select that enemy unit as the target for all of those attacks and those attacks have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

stratagems.name: Beasthide Manifestation
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Flush the Quarry
stratagems.timing: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army and up to three friendly WAR DOG units within 6" of that TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those War Dog units makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, its models can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, they can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape tests it automatically passed.

stratagems.name: Contemptuous Volleys
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Goaded Beast
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

rule.name: Annihilate the Unworthy
rule.rules_text: Friendly KNIGHT TYRANT units' attacks that target a Battle-shocked unit have +1 to the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Pterrorshade Rookery
enhancements.rules_text: KNIGHT TYRANT model only. When this unit is selected to shoot, select one enemy unit within 24" of this unit. That enemy unit has a 6" detection range until this unit has shot.

enhancements.name: Hate-filled Dominion
enhancements.rules_text: KNIGHT TYRANT model only. This unit can re-roll rolls to determine the A of a weapon.

stratagems.name: Rune-cursed Stronghold
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when a friendly KNIGHT TYRANT unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That KNIGHT TYRANT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Pitiless Focus
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly KNIGHT TYRANT unit is selected to make a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That KNIGHT TYRANT unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: Intimidating Reminder
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KNIGHT TYRANT unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That KNIGHT TYRANT unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next Command phase. While a unit is suppressed, that unit's attacks have -1 to Hit rolls.

detachments.name: Hunting Warpack

rule.name: Scenting Fear
rule.rules_text: Once per battle round, per army, in your Shooting phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 12" of a friendly WAR DOG unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.

restrictions: This detachment has the WAR DOGS tag and cannot be taken with another WAR DOGS detachment.

enhancements.name: Soul-spoor Auspicator
enhancements.rules_text: HUNTSMAN unit only. This unit's ranged attacks have +6" R.

enhancements.name: Snarling Rivalry
enhancements.rules_text: EXECUTIONER unit only. This unit's ranged attacks have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

stratagems.name: Insensate Bloodthirst
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly WAR DOG unit.
stratagems.target: That WAR DOG unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+.

stratagems.name: Leash of the Masters
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly WAR DOG unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That WAR DOG unit.
stratagems.effect: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

stratagems.name: Stalking Focus
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly WAR DOG unit within range of an objective.
stratagems.target: That WAR DOG unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

detachments.name: Iconoclast Fiefdom

rule.name: Wretched Thralls
rule.rules_text: You can include DAMNED units in your army (see Codex: Chaos Space Marines). The combined points cost of such units cannot exceed 500 points. Friendly DAMNED units can re-roll Leadership rolls.

restrictions: The combined points cost of DAMNED units cannot exceed 500 points.

enhancements.name: Cruel Lashmaster (Aura)
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. While a friendly DAMNED unit is within 6" of this model, when that unit is selected to make a Normal/Advance/Fall-back move that unit has +2" M until the end of the phase.

enhancements.name: Iconoclast Idol (Aura)
enhancements.rules_text: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. While a friendly DAMNED unit is within 6" of this model, when you target that unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1CP.

stratagems.name: Avenge the Masters!
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when a friendly CHAOS KNIGHTS unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit is marked until the end of the battle. Friendly DAMNED units' attacks that target a marked unit have [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: Dark Sacrifice
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly DAMNED unit (excluding ACCURSED CULTISTS units) within 9" of a friendly CHAOS KNIGHTS model.
stratagems.effect: Select one CHAOS KNIGHTS model within 9" of your unit and roll D3+3. Your DAMNED unit suffers that number of mortal wounds. That CHAOS KNIGHTS model heals that number of wounds.

stratagems.name: Coursing Thralls
stratagems.timing: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly DAMNED unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit is hunted. While a unit is hunted, that unit has +6" detection range.

units.name: Chaos Acastus Knight Asterius

abilities.name: Sunderer of Fortresses
abilities.rules_text: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a VEHICLE, improve the Strength and Damage characteristics of that attack by 1. If that attack targets a FORTIFICATION, improve the Strength and Damage characteristics of that attack by 2 instead.

wargear_options: None.

units.name: Chaos Acastus Knight Porphyrion

abilities.name: Bastion of Firepower
abilities.rules_text: Each time this model Remains Stationary, until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by this model have the Lethal Hits ability.

wargear_options: This model's 2 Acastus autocannons can be replaced with one of the following: 2 lascannons; 1 Acastus autocannon and 1 lascannon.
This model's Acastus ironstorm missile pod can be replaced with 1 helios defence missiles.

units.name: Chaos Cerastus Knight Acheron

abilities.name: Searing Flames
abilities.rules_text: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more attacks made with an Acheron flame cannon. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

abilities.name: Unrestrained Terror (Aura)
abilities.rules_text: While a friendly WAR DOG model is within 6" of this model, it is affected by this ability. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more WAR DOG units affected by this ability must take a Battle-shock test.

wargear_options: None.

units.name: Chaos Cerastus Knight Atrapos

abilities.name: Macro-extinction Protocols
abilities.rules_text: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Hit roll. If that target is TITANIC or TOWERING, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

abilities.name: Consumed with Hunger (Aura)
abilities.rules_text: While a friendly WAR DOG model is within 6" of this model, each time that WAR DOG model makes an attack that targets a TITANIC or TOWERING unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

wargear_options: None.

units.name: Chaos Cerastus Knight Castigator

abilities.name: Storm of Bolts
abilities.rules_text: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, while this model is on the battlefield, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Offerings for the Dark Gods (Aura)
abilities.rules_text: While a friendly WAR DOG model is within 6" of this model, ranged weapons equipped by that WAR DOG model have the Sustained Hits 1 ability.

wargear_options: None.

units.name: Chaos Cerastus Knight Lancer

abilities.name: Shock Charge
abilities.rules_text: You can target this model with the Crushing Impact Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this phase.

abilities.name: Dark Favour (Aura)
abilities.rules_text: While a friendly WAR DOG model is within 6" of this model, ranged weapons equipped by that WAR DOG model have the Assault ability.

wargear_options: None.

units.name: Chaos Questoris Knight Magaera

abilities.name: Huntmaster (Aura)
abilities.rules_text: While a friendly WAR DOG model is within 6" of this model, ranged weapons equipped by that WAR DOG model have the Assault ability.

abilities.name: Repair Auto-simulacra
abilities.rules_text: At the end of your Command phase, this model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

wargear_options: This model's reaper chainsword can be replaced with 1 hekaton siege claw and 1 twin rad cleanser.

units.name: Chaos Questoris Knight Styrix

abilities.name: Preysight (Aura)
abilities.rules_text: While a friendly WAR DOG model is within 6" of this model, ranged weapons equipped by that WAR DOG model have the Ignores Cover ability.

abilities.name: Grav-pinned
abilities.rules_text: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, if an enemy INFANTRY unit was hit by one or more attacks made with a graviton crusher, until the end of your opponent's next turn, that enemy unit is grav-pinned. While a unit is grav-pinned, subtract 2 from that unit's Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that unit.

wargear_options: This model's reaper chainsword can be replaced with 1 hekaton siege claw and 1 twin rad cleanser.

units.name: Knight Abominant

abilities.name: Vortex Terrors (Psychic)
abilities.rules_text: At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to this model. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

abilities.name: Warp Storms (Psychic)
abilities.rules_text: At the end of your Movement phase, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 9" of one or more models with this ability: on a 3+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

wargear_options: None.

units.name: Knight Desecrator

abilities.name: Obsessive Ruthlessness
abilities.rules_text: This unit's ranged attacks that target a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit can ignore modifiers to this unit's Ballistic Skill, Hit rolls and Wound rolls.

abilities.name: Taskmaster (Aura)
abilities.rules_text: While a friendly WAR DOG model is within 9" of this model, each time that WAR DOG model makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

wargear_options: This model's reaper chainsword can be replaced with 1 warpstrike claw.

units.name: Knight Despoiler

abilities.name: Dread Dominion (Aura)
abilities.rules_text: While a friendly WAR DOG model is within 9" of this model, improve that WAR DOG model's Leadership and Objective Control characteristics by 1.

abilities.name: Seething Hatred
abilities.rules_text: Each time this model is selected to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one Hit roll or one Wound roll when resolving those attacks.

selectable_abilities.name: Seething Hatred - Hit roll
selectable_abilities.rules_text: Each time this model is selected to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one Hit roll when resolving those attacks.

selectable_abilities.name: Seething Hatred - Wound roll
selectable_abilities.rules_text: Each time this model is selected to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one Wound roll when resolving those attacks.

wargear_options: This model's daemonbreath meltagun can be replaced with 1 diabolus heavy stubber.

This model's reaper chainsword can be replaced with a daemonbreath thermal cannon and heavy darkflamer; despoiler gatling cannon and diabolus heavy stubber; or despoiler battle cannon and diabolus heavy stubber.
This model's warpstrike claw can be replaced with the same ranged weapon options.
This model can be equipped with one of: havoc missile pod; ruinspore rocket pod; hellstorm autocannons.

units.name: Knight Rampager

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.rules_text: Each time this model makes a Charge move, until the end of the turn, its melee weapons have the Devastating Wounds ability.

abilities.name: Frenzied Rampage (Aura)
abilities.rules_text: While a friendly WAR DOG model is within 9" of this model, each time that WAR DOG model makes a melee attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

wargear_options: None.

units.name: Knight Ruinator

abilities.name: Methodical Destruction
abilities.rules_text: At the start of the first battle round, select one unit from your opponent's army to be this model's victim. Each time this model makes an attack that targets its victim, you can re-roll the Wound roll. Each time this model's victim is destroyed, select one new enemy unit to be this model's victim.

abilities.name: Close-range Killers (Aura)
abilities.rules_text: While a friendly WAR DOG model is within 9" of this model, each time that WAR DOG model makes an attack that targets the closest enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

wargear_options: None.

units.name: Knight Tyrant

abilities.name: Infernal Aegis (Aura)
abilities.rules_text: While a friendly WAR DOG model is within 6" of this model, that WAR DOG model has the Benefit of Cover.

abilities.name: Bastion of Corruption
abilities.rules_text: Enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of this model.

wargear_options: This model's 2 ghaststrike missile launchers and 2 twin Desecrator cannons can be replaced with 1 ghaststrike missile launcher and 2 twin Desecrator cannons.
This model's brimstone volcano lance and ectoplasma decimator can be replaced with 1 darkflame cannon and 1 warpshock harpoon.

units.name: War Dog Brigand

abilities.name: Brigand
abilities.rules_text: Each time this model makes a ranged attack that targets a unit that is within range of one or more objective markers, that attack has the Ignores Cover ability.

wargear_options: This model's diabolus heavy stubber can be replaced with 1 havoc multi-launcher.

units.name: War Dog Executioner

abilities.name: Executioner
abilities.rules_text: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a unit Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. Each time an enemy unit is destroyed as the result of this model's attacks, before removing the last model in that unit from the battlefield, each unit from your opponent's army that is within 3" of it must take a Battle-shock test.

wargear_options: This model's diabolus heavy stubber can be replaced with 1 daemonbreath meltagun.

units.name: War Dog Huntsman

abilities.name: Huntsman
abilities.rules_text: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

wargear_options: This model's diabolus heavy stubber can be replaced with 1 daemonbreath meltagun.

units.name: War Dog Karnivore

abilities.name: Karnivore
abilities.rules_text: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for this model.

wargear_options: This model's diabolus heavy stubber can be replaced with 1 havoc multi-launcher.

units.name: War Dog Moirax

abilities.name: Protection Protocols
abilities.rules_text: You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem for 0CP, regardless of any other uses of that Stratagem this phase. If you do: that use is -1CP; that use does not prevent uses of that Stratagem on other units this phase.

wargear_options: This model's graviton pulsar can be replaced with one of the following: 1 siege claw and 1 rad cleanser; 1 lightning lock; 1 conversion beam cannon.
This model's volkite veuglaire can be replaced with one of the following: 1 siege claw and 1 rad cleanser; 1 graviton pulsar; 1 lightning lock; 1 conversion beam cannon.

units.name: War Dog Stalker

abilities.name: Stalker
abilities.rules_text: Each time this model makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, if there are no other units from your opponent's army within 6" of that target, add 1 to the Wound roll.

wargear_options: This model's avenger chaincannon can be replaced with 1 daemonbreath spear.
This model's diabolus heavy stubber can be replaced with 1 havoc multi-launcher.
This model's slaughterclaw can be replaced with 1 reaper chaintalon.
